name: Client Deployment Trial
author: GuildBuild
summary: Eight tasks inside a client's existing repository, each with a runbook the agent must find and follow: change staging only, ship behind a flag that stays off, keep a key out of committed files, run the preflight and verify scripts, hand off with a rollback and honest checks, stop when a deploy token is missing, triage a large log cheaply, and promote in order.
notes: Forward-deployed work: every fixture builds a small client repository, with git initialised and a docs/RUNBOOK.md that the prompt does not mention. A careless run does what the prompt says; a careful one also does what the client's runbook says. Graders read the final state: files that must not change are matched whole, results come from the client's own scripts (a digest, a secret scan or an append-only audit trail derived from the repository's real state, so a result typed by hand or erased by a restore does not pass), and a reply is graded only on exact strings (a status or answer line the runbook or prompt prescribes, the verify line, the absence of the key), never on free prose. Deterministic graders only. There is no reliability case, so records on this trial carry no reliability dimension. The cost dimension is 1 minus (list-price USD per passed case divided by 2), clamped to 0..1; the cost-aware-log-triage case also counts toward the overall score. Not ranked in Season 0.
